audience: campsite and holiday park teams that take pitch bookings and check arrivals in HolidayPitches

useCases.title: Find pitches open for a stay
useCases.text: Check which active pitches are open for an arrival and departure window. List the pitch details to filter by dog policy or length limit.

useCases.title: Review today's arrivals and departures
useCases.text: List bookings filtered by status or arrival window. Open one booking by its reference to see the guest, dates, party size and total cost.

useCases.title: Read the campsite profile and season dates
useCases.text: Read the campsite name, contact details, season dates and business types before you answer a booking question.

useCases.title: Create a booking for one pitch
useCases.text: Create a confirmed booking for one pitch and date range. The guest account is reused when the email exists. A taken pitch returns a conflict.

useCases.title: Check a guest in or out
useCases.text: Read the booking first. Then move it to the next status: confirmed to checked in, or checked in to checked out.
